results.title: Runway News | Runway launches Student Ambassador Program
excerpts:
News / Company News

Runway launches Student Ambassador Program

Today we are excited to announce the launch of our Student Ambassador Program to support students as they prepare to embark on their professional careers.
December 12, 2024 · by Runway
This program welcomes all students who share our fascination with the intersection of art and technology and are looking to apply Runway’s tools to their studies in art, film, architecture, computer science, design, or any other discipline that can benefit from the use of this emerging technology.
Students enrolled in this program will receive 100k complimentary credits, a complimentary Pro plan, networking opportunities, as well as access to the Runway team. It’s a program that strives to not only reduce the friction involved in accessing AI video tools for students, but to help connect students to both their peers and to industry professionals.
We are thrilled to be working with students and universities from all over the world including NYU, Rhode Island School of Design, University of the Arts London, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology, USC, Loyola Marymount, UCLA, School of Visual Arts, and many more.
Student Ambassador Program
If you are interested in applying for Runway’s Student Ambassador Program, or if you’re an educator looking for support, please let us know at https://runway.com/educators

Discover more

results.title: Pika Team | LinkedIn
excerpts:
Pika is a student-led nonprofit expanding access to authentic research education for the next generation of scientists, innovators, and changemakers. We believe research should be learned by doing, not just reading about it. Through structured courses, personalized mentorship, workshops, and publication opportunities, we help students develop the skills to ask meaningful questions, analyze real-world data, and communicate scientific discoveries. Our programs emphasize computational biology, medicine, public health, and health equity while teaching broadly applicable research skills that can be used across STEM disciplines. Students progress from learning the foundations of research to designing independent projects and producing publication-ready work. Beyond education, Pika is building a global community where students learn from mentors, collaborate with peers, and contribute to open science. By making research more accessible, we aim to empower students from all backgrounds to participate in scientific discovery and create meaningful impact.

excerpts:
OpenAI Student Collective

OpenAI Campus Lead に応募する学生同士がプロジェクトに取り組みながら、ChatGPT と Codex を自信を持って使えるよう支援します。
応募する／関心を登録する ニュースレターに登録する （新しいウィンドウで開く）
共有する

...

OpenAI Student Collective は、学部生の Campus Lead にツール、トレーニング、資金、サポートを提供し、その熱意をキャンパスでさらに広げられるよう支援します。
あらゆる分野の仲間をつなぎ、OpenAI のツールを自信を持って使えるよう支援し、その成果をグローバルコミュニティに紹介することに意欲的な学生を募集しています。

プログラムの仕組み

Campus Lead は2人1組で活動し、学生が最新の AI ツールを学び、新たなプロジェクトを始め、その過程で作ったものを共有できる場をつくります。
大学の講義室で行われているAIワークショップで手を挙げる学生たち。

ワークショップ

学生が新しい AI スキルを学び、何を作れるかを探り、Studio Hours で継続して取り組むプロジェクトを選ぶ、誰もが参加しやすいイベントです。
各学期4回
スタジオアワー中に、長いテーブルを囲んでノートパソコンを使って共同作業をする学生たち。

スタジオアワー

学生が自分のプロジェクトに集中して取り組み、仲間と交流し、必要に応じてサポートを受けられる、毎週開催の共同作業セッションです。
毎週
プレゼンテーションが表示された大きなスクリーンの前で、マイクに向かって話している人物の画像

成果発表会

学生が AI を使って生み出した成果を、キャンパス全体で称えるイベントです。
各学期に1回
首に名札を下げ、笑顔の人々の写真

コミュニティ

学生同士がつながり、質問をしたり、今後の活動機会を見つけたりできる共有スペースです。
常時

提供されるもの

* プログラム期間中利用できる ChatGPT のサブスクリプションと Codex クレジット

...

* 2027年6月の 本社訪問の機会 や、プログラムを通じたさまざまなサプライズ

学生コミュニティを通じて

Arlina Yang Krishna Ramasimha Daira Velasquez Fonseca

応募方法

日本、韓国、英国、ドイツ、フランスの学生を対象に、2026年8月31日まで応募を受け付けています。米国、カナダ、インドでは、2026年秋期の応募受付を終了しています。

...

の国で応募受付が終了している場合や、プログラムがまだ提供されていない場合でも、応募できます。プログラムの拡大に伴い、今後の募集で選考対象となります。
専攻分野を問わず、学生の皆さんからの応募を歓迎します。私たちは、好奇心旺盛で、コミュニティを大切にし、周囲の人に AI を紹介することに意欲的な学部生を募集しています。

応募資格

* ChatGPT、Codex、OpenAI のツールが好きであること。
* 18歳以上であること。
* 2026年8月時点で大学の学部課程に在籍し、2028年1月以降に卒業予定であること。
* 2026年8月から2027年6月まで、週4～6時間の活動時間を確保できること。
* 米国、カナダ、英国、フランス、ドイツ、インド、日本、または韓国で学び、就学先の国で就労許可を有していること。

During Misra's time leading design engineering at Snap Inc. , he followed the rise of a new category of video, the "talking video." [ 1 ] Later that year, the Captions app launched with early backing from venture capital firms Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz as well as individual investors. [ 2 ] [ 3 ]
In 2023, the company released Lipdub, an Al dubbing app which translates any video with spoken audio into 28 languages. [ 4 ] [ 5 ]

Registration Opens for Ambassador’s Ship Visit Program in UK

* February 3, 2026
Ambition
Ambassador Cruise Line has opened registration for its 2026 program to visit its no-fly fleet in the UK for trade partners and agents, the company stated in a press release.
Since its launch in 2022, the program has welcomed several hundred agents aboard Ambassador’s ex-UK fleet of small-to-midsize ships.
This year’s edition will offer participants a chance to have the “Ambassador experience” onboard two sister ships, Ambience and Ambition, at one of seven regional ports in the UK.
The company expects 700 agents to take advantage of the 14 opportunities – two more than last year – to get onboard the two ships over the course of the year.
Guests will be able to visit the 1,400-passenger Ambiance on May 19 2026 at London Cruise Terminal in Tilbury, Essex.
Visits to the 1,200-passenger Ambition will be possible on several dates spanning from April to October:
* April 22, 2026 – Portsmouth
* May 8, 2026; June 4, 2026 – Belfast
* May 29, 2026; June 15, 2026 – Liverpool
* July 1, 2026; August 21, 2026 – Dundee
* August 26, 2026; September 3, 2026 – Newcastle
* October 16, 2026; November 11, 2026 – Bristol
* November 13, 2026; December 1, 2026 – London Cruise Terminal

Hayden Bland chairs the 2026 Nuclear Engineering Student Delegation

By Munmun
Delegate, then Vice Chair, and now Chair. Our Hayden Bland has officially climbed the entire NESD ladder!
In late September, Hayden chaired the 2026 Nuclear Engineering Student Delegation (NESD), leading 15 delegates from universities nationwide to Washington, D.C. The delegation met with numerous congressional offices to advocate for nuclear energy, education, and research. They also met with industry partners, think tanks, the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Nuclear Energy, the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, and Chairman Ho Nieh of the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
From his very first delegation, Hayden has encouraged students in the nuclear sciences to get involved, and this year is no different. If you are interested, apply at http://www.nesd.org .
We are proud of Hayden for leading this year’s delegation. Congratulations, Chair Bland!

Markdown としてコピー

GitHub Campus Experts プログラムへの申請

GitHub Campus Expertsプログラムに申し込むには、まず申請フォームを提出してから、ビデオ履歴書を提出する必要があります。 応募受付は毎年 7 月に開始され、応募期間は 1 か月間です。
メモ
申請プロセスは申請者を知るのに役立ちます。 以下に、あなたについて知る必要があることをいくつか示します。
* やる気: 動機は何ですか? 何があなたをやる気にさせていますか?
* 関心: なぜプログラムに参加したいのですか?
* 成長と可能性: 学びたいスキルは何ですか? また、それはあなたが個人的にかつ仕事上で成長するのにどのように役立ちますか?
* 貢献: キャンパスにどのような影響を与えたいですか?

対象となる条件

GitHub Campus Expertにするには、次の手順を実行する必要があります。
* 少なくとも 6 か月間 GitHub ユーザーになる。
* 18 歳以上であること。
* 正規の高等教育機関に在籍していること。
* 卒業までの在籍期間が 1 年以上残っていること。
* GitHub Student Developer Pack を使用して学生の状態を検証します。

申請フォームの提出

申請フォームでは、学生コミュニティが直面する課題、仲間のためにどのような機会を作りたいか、成長の可能性を示す学生を探します。
1. https://education.github.com/campus_experts に移動します。
2. アプリケーションが開いているかどうかを確認するには、[ キャンパスエキスパートになる ]をクリック。
3. 募集が行われている場合は、"あなたの旅はここから始まります" というタイトルの新しいページが表示されます。 申請を始めるには、 [今すぐ申請] をクリックします。
それ以外の場合、募集が終了していれば、次の募集サイクルの日付を含むメッセージが表示されます。
4. フォームのプロンプトに従って、申請を完了します。
5. [申請の提出] をクリックします。
6. 必要に応じて、申請が正常に提出されたことを確かめるには、提出の確認メールで指定したメール アドレスを調べます。
7. プログラムの募集が終了してから 2 週間後に、最新の申請状況と動画履歴書の提出手順を含むメールを確認します。

excerpts:
Applying to be a GitHub Campus Expert

As a student, you can apply to be a GitHub Campus Expert to gain new skills and grow your college's technical community.

Applying to the GitHub Campus Experts program

To apply to the GitHub Campus Experts program, you must first submit an application form, then submit a video resume. Applications to the program open every July, and you’ll have a full month to apply.
[!NOTE] The application process helps us get to know the applicant. Here are some things we want to learn about you:
* Motivation: What makes you tick? What drives you?
* Interest: Why do you want to be part of the program?

...

Eligibility criteria

To become a GitHub Campus Expert, you must:
* Be a GitHub user for at least six months.
* Be at least 18 years of age.
* Be enrolled in a formal higher education institution.
* Have more than one year left as a student before graduating.
* Validate your student status through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.

Submitting your application form

In the application form, we’re looking for students to tell us about the challenges their student community faces, what opportunities they want to build for their peers, and the potential they see for growth.
1. Go to https://education.github.com/campus_experts.
2. To learn if applications are open, click Become a Campus Expert .
3. If applications are open, a new page will appear titled “Your journey starts here”. To start your application, click Apply Now.

Windsurf ambassador s play a significant role in promoting the sport of windsurfing, serving as influential figures who inspire and engage both current and potential participants. Here are some key insights into their contributions:
1. **Promotion of the Sport**: Windsurf ambassador s are often skilled athletes who showcase their talents in competitions and events. By excelling in their sport, they attract attention and inspire others to take up windsurfing. Their visibility helps to raise awareness and interest in the sport [1 ].
2. **Brand Representation**: Many windsurf ambassador s are affiliated with specific brands or companies that manufacture windsurfing equipment. They represent these brands, often participating in marketing campaigns, product launches, and promotional events.

...

September 11, 2026 12:39 Updated
Student Ambassadors are selected via an application process.
To be eligible to apply:
* You participated and submitted a project in at least one Technovation Challenge season
* You must be between the ages of 13 and 18 as of October 1 of the year of application
Please note: It is crucial for Student Ambassadors to help guide new participants through the entire participation process, including submission. It is therefore a requirement that applicants have submitted a project at least once while participating in the Technovation Challenge Challenge.
If you have not yet submitted a project, we strongly encourage you to join us next season as a participant instead. Participating will give you the experience you will need for future volunteer leadership.
You do not need to submit any consent or agreement forms with your application. lp-build-highly-available-agentic-memory

How to build a multi-region, highly available, high-performance agent memory with Mem0 & ScyllaDB

Want to build agentic memory into your AI apps, but not sure how to make it reliable, accurate, and fast?
Join Mem0 and ScyllaDB for a developer workshop where we will build a multi-region, highly available, high-performance agent memory. Along the way, you will discover the components of low-latency agentic systems that unify agent memory and state to provide accurate responses to the user.

* Design a performant database schema that stores structured facts, embeddings, and metadata side by side — no separate vector database required

June 27, 2026 1 minute read
The Apollo Africa Leadership Foundation (AALF) has called for applications for its 2026 Campus Ambassadors Program.
The AALF Campus Ambassadors Program will reward passionate student leaders with cash prizes, gadgets, gifts, as well as internship, mentorship, and networking opportunities.

Eligibility Requirements

To be considered for the Apollo Africa Leadership Foundation Campus Ambassadors Program, you must:
* be individuals passionate about youth empowerment, tech & innovation
* be current undergraduate students
* be student leaders, influencers, and community builders.
* have strong communicators with a passion for impact
* be students eager to grow their network and leadership experience.

Benefits

As an AALF Campus Ambassador, you will enjoy the following rewards;
* Cash prizes and performance rewards
* Opportunity to win devices and exciting gifts
* Exclusive AALF merchandise
* Publicity and recognition across AALF platforms
* Access to internship opportunities
* Mentorship and networking with industry leaders and changemakers

Roles

As a campus ambassador, you will;
* Represent AALF on your campus
* Organize student-focused initiatives and events
* Build and engage a vibrant student community
* Connect students to opportunities that matter

NVIDIA学生アンバサダー合同ワークショップに、東京工科大の学生アンバサダー10名が参加！

2026年4月09日掲出
2026年2月28日、大阪を代表する繁華街に位置する、大阪工業大学梅田キャンパスにて、「～GPUを用いた技術の深層と応用の最前線～AI・デジタルツイン・ロボティクス 学生アンバサダー合同ワークショップ」が開催され、現地の会場とオンラインをあわせて約80名の参加がありました。
このワークショップは、「NVIDIA学生アンバサダープログラム※」に参加している学生が企画・運営を行い、NVIDIAの先端技術を活用した研究・開発などの成果を発表するものです。東京工科大学からは全国の大学で最多の10名が、AI・LLMセッション、デジタルツインセッション、ロボティクスセッション、ポスターセッションの各セッションで発表やハンズオン形式の学習体験を実施。また、合同ワークショップ全体の司会進行役も務めました。
※「NVIDIA学生アンバサダープログラム」とは････世界的半導体企業NVIDIAが世界中で提供する学生支援プログラム。AIやデータサイエンス、ロボティクスなどの最新の動向を共有することに意欲を示し、修得したスキルでさまざまなタスクを実践できる学生の育成を目的としている。東京工科大学では、全国の大学で最多の10名が学生アンバサダーに任命されている。（2026年2月現在）
ワークショップは、佐野睦夫氏（大阪工業大学 イノベーションデザイン教育研究センター 所長・学長補佐）からの始めの挨拶、続いて八馬遼氏（NVIDIA Research/博士（工学））からの招待講演でスタート。２フロアにまたがった会場で、各セッションが行われました。

Getting started with Modal

Using Modal requires an account. If you or your organization do not yet have an account, visit the signup page to begin the process. Enterprise user accounts may also be managed via SAML SSO or SCIM .
You can also ask an agent to help you get set up:
Read https://modal.com/docs/guide/getting-started.md and walk me through Modal setup.

Install the Modal CLI 

The modal CLI is a key tool for interacting with the platform. It will be installed alongside the Python SDK:
uv pip conda
uv add modal
If using Modal in a TypeScript or Go project, you can also install the CLI as a standalone tool via uvx.sh :
curl -LsSf uvx.sh/modal/install.sh | sh

Set up a Modal token 

You’ll need a Modal token to use service. After installing the CLI, run this command to configure your local system:
modal setup
This step requires a web browser for authentication. Once the setup flow completes, you can verify that the token works:
modal token info

Install agent skills 

Modal provides a skill that helps coding agents work most effectively with the platform.
The skill can be installed and maintained via the CLI:
modal skills install  # [--claude] [--global]

Contributing to Megatron-LM #

This document outlines the processes and policies for issues and pull requests by non-NVIDIA contributors to the Megatron-LM GitHub repository.
Everyone is welcome to contribute. The project recently migrated from an internal repository to doing all development directly on GitHub.
When contributing, it is important to ensure that changes are in line with the project direction. Small bug fixes are always welcome. If proposing large architectural changes or changes for stylistic reasons, open an issue first for discussion.

Issue Policy #

File any bugs you find, keeping the following in mind:
* If filing a bug, that is, you have found something that does not work as expected, use the BUG template.
* If you’ve found a regression in speed or accuracy, use the REGRESSION template.
* If you are requesting a new feature or modification of an existing feature, use the ENHANCEMENT template.
* If opening an issue to ask a question, you do not need a template, but make your question as clear and concise as possible.
* One issue per bug.

...

* Format new code in a style that is consistent with the file being changed. Megatron-LM doesn’t (yet) have a style guide or enforced formatting.

...

* Include commented-out code.
* Attempt large architectural changes without first opening an issue to discuss.

Signing Your Work #

* We require that all contributors “sign-off” on their commits.

We’re launching a community-driven Ambassador Program to bring our events, ideas, and research into cities around the world—and we’d love your help! Ambassadors will help organize local meetups or co-lead workshops that connect builders, researchers, and AI enthusiasts. The program is open to students, professionals, and independent builders alike—anyone excited to foster community around Phoenix.
This program is perfect for people who are building with and using Phoenix, enjoy bringing communities together, and are excited about AI and open source.
Here are some perks...
Swag & Event Kits: We’ll ship you exclusive ambassador swag and help with event materials (swag, signage, decks, etc.) to make your meetup shine.
Event Stipend: If you’re hosting a local meetup and want to feature Phoenix, you can apply for an event stipend of up to $500 to host your event
Promotion & Amplification: We’ll help promote your event through our channels and spotlight standout organizers in our blog, newsletter, and/or social.
Build Your Network & Reputation: Grow your local AI community while building visibility as a trusted thought leader in reasoning systems and LLMs.
Early Access to Research & Product Updates: Get sneak peeks at our latest work, including papers, tools, and product features—before they’re public.

Fill out this quick application to be considered.
